notes.title: Patch 0.3
notes.notes:
Greetings, Sorcerers!  

With patch 0.3.0, we approach the end of Sorcevival. While the initial idea was for patch 0.3 to be the final content patch, the game's conclusion isn't ready yet. Access to the end will be unlocked in patch 0.4, which will indeed be the last content update for Sorcevival. When we release version 1.0, no new content will be added, marking the game as complete. It's been a long journey, but everything has an end. In this patch, we've added the final map, The City, where you can face the last remnants of evil. Additionally, there's more secret content we hope you'll be able to discover!  

New Content  

  
 New Map Added: The City. Enemies specific to this map may resist fire and air, but beware, as you'll start by facing forest enemies, resistant to earth and water.  
 Secret: The Angel will no longer remain silent.  
 New mission added.  
  

Balancing  

  
 The Vitality upgrade now grants Health per Level instead of flat Health. This upgrade had almost no effect by the end of the game.  
 Maximum number of enemies reduced from 500 to 300. This change shouldn't be too noticeable, as no more than 330 enemies were spawning, except for horde enemies.  
 Some plant enemies now grant less experience.  
 The Divine Cross relic now has a 20% chance to convert an item into wine, instead of 100%.  
  

Miscellaneous and Bug Fixes  

  
 The Boss Soul image now has an animation.  
 The volume of spells cast by the Familiar has been reduced.  
 Multiple performance improvements have been made.  
 Lightning arcs should now perform better.  
 When an enemy takes multiple damage instances in the same frame, the damage is now displayed as a single number, which should help with performance.  
 Fixed an issue where the Legendary Spell Speed passive would cause a negative cooldown reduction on Dash.  
 Corrected a typo in the Divine Cross description.  
 Fixed a bug that caused some sounds to play simultaneously.  
  

That's all for this patch. We'll see you in the next one!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.8
notes.notes:
Greetings, sorcerers!

There’s not much time left before the last content patch, Patch 0.3, which will kick off the final stage of Early Access. In the meantime, we bring you a patch to help us prepare. The main features of this update are the new character, the Elementalist, and the new spell, the Familiar. Read the patch notes carefully for more details!

New


 New Character - The Elementalist: This sorceress, a master of the elements, is lost in the Forest (in Challenge Mode), waiting to be freed. When you play as her, you can attune to one of the basic elements, transforming all your spells into that element. Additionally, if you speak with her, she may give you hints on how to finally defeat the evil once and for all.
 New Spell - Familiar: Can be purchased in the shop. You will no longer be alone!
 7 New Quests: Five of them related to the new character, and the other two are preparation for the next patch.
 2 New Upgrades: Time to spend those accumulated Boss Souls.


Balance


 Increased the experience required to level up: From levels 1 to 50, the difference should be negligible, and this mainly affects levels beyond 100. The player's power scaling was too high compared to the difficulty.
 Enemy experience drops now scale less over time. At the end of the run, it is reduced by about 15%.
 Expanded Mind Passive - Common: Experience bonus reduced from +5% to +2%
 Expanded Mind Passive - Uncommon: Experience bonus reduced from +10% to +5%
 Expanded Mind Passive - Rare: Experience bonus reduced from +15% to +10%
 Expanded Mind Passive - Epic: Experience bonus reduced from +25% to +15%
 Expanded Mind Passive - Legendary: Experience bonus reduced from +35% to +25%
 Quick Cast Passive - Legendary: Attack Speed bonus reduced from +30% to +25%
 Arcane Path Spell - Devastating Charge Upgrade: Dash reduction decreased from -75% to -60%
 Enemies can now pass through barriers created by Bosses.


Miscellaneous


 Improved the Spell Upgrade Interface.
 Reduced the number of particles in Arcane Orbit.
 Reduced the volume of the Electric Nova.
 Numerous changes have been made to improve performance.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue related to quests.
 Fixed a bug that allowed the purchase of locked upgrades.


These are all the changes. We hope you enjoy Sorcevival and look forward to the next update. Don’t hesitate to recommend the game! See you in the next patch!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.7.1
notes.notes: Fixed a Crash when using wine on The Forest

notes.title: Patch 0.2.7
notes.notes:
Greetings, sorcerers!

Today we bring you a small patch, but a larger one is almost ready. There are some minor changes and bug fixes, but the most important update is the new Profile system. You can now have different profiles with different progress on each one. Unfortunately, you'll lose your current stats with this patch. We hope you enjoy this new update!

New


 New Profile system. You can now create different profiles on the same account. Unfortunately, current stats will be erased. However, your progress is safe.
 3 New relics.
 2 New quests related to the new relics.
 New rune added, which grants Armor Penetration.


Balance


 You no longer get knocked back when the Arcane Shield breaks.


Miscellaneous


 Reduced damage by armor is now displayed above enemies' heads. Previously, it appeared as a gray number in parentheses, which wasn't clear enough.
 The interaction between luck and props has been adjusted.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed a Bug related to the quest board.
 Fixed a bug where enemy arrows would fly backward.
 Fixed several issues related to using a controller in the pause menu.
 Fixed a bug where extremely high luck always resulted in passives of the highest available rarity.
 Fixed a bug where DPS at the end of a run was several times higher than it should have been. Goodbye to those 60k DPS numbers—let’s see if you can hit 15k now!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.6
notes.notes:
Greetings, Sorcerers!

In this patch, we've introduced the combination of elements! Now, you can add a second element to a spell, creating a combined element. Both the enhancements of the two elements separately and the enhancement of the combined element will be applied, making your spells much more powerful! Feel free to discover what new elements there are.

New Content

[olist]
Added combinable elements. You can now add a second element to a spell and obtain a combined element.
[/olist]

Balance

[olist]
Max. Luck  from upgrades reduced from 25% to 20%
Chances of Passive Raritys have been tweeked
Chances to obtain an Elemental Rune increased from 30% to 35%
[/olist]

Misc and Bug Fixes

[olist]
Added a visual effect in the Rune view to symbolize the Rune's element.
Increased the scroll speed in the Lobby Statistics view.
Fixed a bug where clicking the Menu button did not open it.
Fixed a bug where the spell name did not update with the elements in the Pause menu.
Fixed a bug where the probability of Elemental Runes was 70% instead of 30%.
[/olist]

We hope you enjoy this new patch of Sorcevival and that you provide us with your feedback on the changes made. May your spells be precise, and may you continue to survive!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.5
notes.notes:
Greetings sorcerers!

This week the patch isn't very loaded because we're working on the next one. However, some of the changes in this patch were crucial, so we couldn't postpone them for another week.

New Content


New Passive: With this new passive, reaching level 150 will be within your grasp.


Balance


Option Generation upon Level Up changed. Now, instead of choosing 3 options from all available ones, you first choose whether they will be spells, passives, or spell upgrades. This way, having many passives does not decrease the chance of getting a spell or upgrade.
Quick Casting Passive - Epic: Duration of Attack Speed increase after collecting mana reduced from 3 sec to 1 sec.
Quick Casting Passive - Legendary: Duration of Attack Speed increase after collecting mana reduced from 5 sec to 1 sec.


Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue that caused the incorrect display of the amount of mana or Boss souls collected.
Fixed some Memory Leaks.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.4.3
notes.notes:
Sorcevival is now on sale for the Spring Sales!

This is a small patch with some needed Hot-Fixes. Remember, Gods will be watching.


Now there will be no armor numbers if the damage done was 0.
Uncommon rarity passive background has been tweaked.
Fixed a visual bug where Relic Mana Well showed 1% less damage than it should.
Fixed a bug where other stats pages were scrolled after scrolling on the passive page.
Fixed a bug where you could scroll more than intended on the Stats Passive Page.
Fixed a visual bug when teleporting after finishing a run.
Fixed a bug where you would stop attacking if you had 6000% Attack Speed or more.
Fixed a crash that occurred when you had Critical Rune and there were no enemies.

notes.title: HotFix 0.2.4.1
notes.notes: Fixed a Crash with the shop

notes.title: Patch 0.2.4
notes.notes:
Greetings, Sorcerer!

This week we bring you a rework to the Passive system! You will start with Common and Uncommon Passives, but in the shop, you can buy new rarities, such as Rare, Epic, or Legendary! Could there be a rarer one? That's a secret only the Gods know for sure. This new system may bring imbalance, so tweaks to the values are expected. Don't hesitate to share your feedback with us!

New Content


Passives Rework: Now Passives have Rarities. Luck increases the chance of obtaining better rarities.
New Passives: Two new Passives had been introduced.


Balance


Arcane Path: Now always summons at least 1 arrea
Relic - Mana Well: Dmg per stack increased from 10% to 20%
The spawn of enemies in the first few minutes of the Dungeon Level has been adjusted to reduce its difficulty.


Misc and Bug Fixes


Now you can see the experience numbers with the Expand Passives button. They will also appear automatically when you are next to a Rune or Active.
Added sounds and effects to end game Screen
Added new sounds when a Character speaks
Arcane Orbit particle position tweaked.
Fixed a Bug where the Character stands up after death animation.


We hope you like these changes and continue to enjoy Sorcevival! May your spells hit your target and keep on surviving!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.3.1
notes.notes:
Small patch focused on performance.

Balance


Plant Ranged Enemy Attack Speed reduced from 0.65 to 0.5
Luck  has been reworked. Now you shouldn't get too many items with higher luck.


Misc and Bug fixes


Nova visual Effect Size increased to better match real size
Particle position tweaked

notes.title: Patch 0.2.3
notes.notes:
Greetings Sorcerers!

In today's patch, we bring forth a new ally to combat the forces of evil: The Apprentice! This new sorcerer has been imprisoned in the dungeons of the Tower, from where we must rescue him to add him to our ranks. He will appear on the Dungeon map in Challenge Mode starting from minute 10. Find him and set him free!

New Content


New Character: The Apprentice. Unlock it on map Dungeon, Challenge Mode, starting from minute 10.  
3 new Quest relative to The Apprentice added.
Now you'll be able to see the information of the equipped item and active in the stats menu.


Balance


Forest, Challenge Mode: Now Fire nor Air can appear as 100% resistance.


Miscellaneous and Bugfixes


Added new sounds to stats menu while using a gamepad.
Experience Bar is smoother now.
Background is darker on Pause Menu.
Fixed position of "Y" button on Stats View while using a gamepad
Fixed a bug where "Y" press info appear even if no gamepad was connected.
Fixed a bug where Pause Menu disabled after pressing "Y" on Stats View
Fixed a bug involving white screen flash


We look forward to seeing you in the next patch with more content! May your spells reach their target and keep on surviving!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Sorcerers!

This week's patch comes with the inclusion of the Steam API. This will allow us to add Steam achievements and other Steam features in the future. For now, you can enjoy Steam Cloud, keeping your game progress synced across devices.

Change list


Added Steam Cloud.
Added an effect when character has low hp.
Now you can see descriptions of your spells, relics and passives in the stats menu. To access them while using a gamepad, press "Y".
Now you receive extra Mana while Quest are locked.
Now you receive extra Luck while Quest are locked.


See you in next patch. May your spells hit their mark, and keep on surviving!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1
notes.notes:
Greetings, Sorcerers!

This new patch is centered around Accessibility, bringing help for those who need it. Allows you to adjust (both decrease and increase) the game speed and customize colors for enemies, props, and the player. This way, we hope everyone can enjoy Sorcevival! We've also made other adjustments that you can see below.

Accessibility


Now you can adjust game speed between 50% and 150%
Now you can customice colors for enemies, props and the player


Balance


Chance of rune being elemental decreased from 35% to 30%


Interface


Added to the end game screen: Monsters Killed, Total DPS, Max Dmg and Final Lvl 
Now Passives are collapsed. You may press tab or left shoulder button to expand them
Now the interface swap places when you are on the bottom right corner, so it doesn't obscure sight


Miscellaneous and Bug Fixes


Sorcevival logo has been tweak
Fixed a bug where you cannot select different levels on the teleport while using a gamepad
Fixed a bug where skeletons start spawning on the new map
Fixed a memory leak involving character Passives
Fixed a bug where Passives disappear after opening Pause Menu
Fixed a bug that wrongly count DPS and DMG if enemy had armor and/or resistances



Esperamos que estos cambios faciliten las cosas a aquellos que lo necesiten. Que vuestros hechizos alcancen su objetivo y seguid sobreviviendo!

It's been a couple of months since the game release, but here you have a new patch with a new map to purge: the Forest! . This is the first patch of the year, and we hope the wait wasn't to long. For now on we will try to make smaller patches while working on big ones to avoid long waits without new content. Now, time to enjoy Sorcevival!

New Content


New Map Added: Forest. This new map can be unlocked completing a quest on the Quest Board. Be careful, some of the new enemies have earth and water resistances. Luckily, plants don't like fire too much.


Balanceo


Now runes have a fixed probability of being elemental (35%), so no matter how much runes you unlock, there will be always the same amount of elemental ones.
Heals dropped from props now heal an additional 5% of player max health
Base HP increased for the Fungus Enemy with HP recover
Boss Fungus Amalgama: Now 2 consecutive areas can not overlap

  Enemies on Challenge Mode have additional Damage

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Greetings, Sorcerers! 

Last week, we launched the game, and there have already been some minor patches, addressing bugs and making some balance tweaks. Now, just before Christmas, we bring you the first patch with new content! We hope you're enjoying Sorcevival and continue to do so. The theme of this patch revolves around the Dash.

New Content


New Game Mode, Challenge Mode: This is a more challenging game mode where each run grants random Elemental Resistances to enemies, along with better rewards! Feel free to let us know what you think of this game mode!
Statistics View: Now, when pausing the game during a session, you can view your character's statistics. In upcoming patches, we'll be adding more information.
Added death animation
Added a new item
Added a new Rune
Added a new Passive
Added a new Spell
Added a new Active Spell
Added a new Relic
Added 6 new quests


Balance


Active Spell, Disintegrate: Armor Penetration increased from 0% to 100%. It should now truly disintegrate enemies.
Earth Rune: The number of fragments it creates has been slightly reduced.
Arcane Projectile, Fatal Finesse (Homing): Attack speed reduced from 40% to 20%.
Arcane Orbit, Enhanced First Row: Atk. Spd. 35% to 40% / Atk. Spd, 20% to 25% / Dmg 3 to 4.
Arcane Orbit, Enhanced Fourth Row: Penetration from 1 to 2 and Dmg from 4 to 5 / Penetration from 0 to 1 and Dmg from 5 to 7.
Boss, Undead Sorcerer: Movement speed increased from 1 to 1.5.
Boss, Beast of Doom: Changed summoned skeletons in phase 1 to the fungus version.


Misc and BugFixes


Now, Augments cannot be purchased until the "Relics" Augment has been bought. This ensures that the first Boss Soul will unlock this previously unseen part of the gameplay.
Changed the icon for Break  Runes and Active Spells to the red Experience icon for better understanding.
Runes and Active Spells can no longer spawn outside the level, preventing them from being unreachable.
Fixed a crash that occurred when using a Gamepad and going to apply a rune when there were no spells available. (Now truly fixed)
Fixed a bug where dying to a Boss's area could cause the area to reappear in a fresh run.
Fixed a UI bug in the Augments window when using a Gamepad.
Fixed a bug that allowed exiting the game by clicking on the end game window.
Fixed a bug that allowed performing a "Super" Dash.
Fixed some typos.
Fixed a bug that caused props to keep spawning after finishing the game.
Fixed a bug that made movement speed upgrades only work after performing a Dash.
Fixed a bug that caused the current Critical Damage to display incorrectly on the level-up screen.


Have a pleasant holiday season, and see you in the next patch. May your spells hit their mark, and keep on surviving!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Sorcerers! This marks our first balance patch, arriving just in time for the weekend. We've tweaked some key elements to enhance your early-game experience. Now, it should be easier to reach the first boss, making your early-game journey smoother and more rewarding.

MANA GAIN
 - Elites now drop a small amount of Mana.
 - Minimum Mana dropped from props increased from 1 to 5.
 - Chance of Mana dropped from props increased from 20% to 25%.

EARLY DIFFICULTY
 - Lowered enemy spawn rates before 12 minutes.
 - Experience dropped by Undead Enemies increased.
 - First Event, Skull Wall: Movement Speed Decreased, making it easier to avoid.
 - Now the first 2 Elites are guaranteed to be melee, instead of just the first one.
 - Caster Elites' base HP reduced.
 - Changed spawn pools for enemies before minute 5 to make them easier.

MISC
 - Boss Souls moved to the right side on the reward screen to avoid text overlapping.
 - Now you can reset Augments to try new things.
 - Now you cannot buy Relics until you buy Relic Augment. This should avoid wasting a Boss Soul too early.

BUG FIXES
 - Fixed a crash when no available items left in the shop.
 - Fixed a bug where enemy shields block enemy projectiles.
 - Fixed a bug where Potion healed a decimal amount.

We hope these adjustments make your journey more enjoyable. We'll continue working on a new patch with additional content. May your spells be powerful, and try to survive!
